# Ananthagiri Hills Camping by Hyderabad Campers Club (HCC)

> Ananthagiri Hills camping near Vikarabad, 2 hours from Hyderabad: compare 4 overnight camps (pool, adventure, lakeside, premium). Tents, meals and bonfire from ₹1,600.

Four overnight campsites in the Ananthagiri Hills near Vikarabad, run by Hyderabad Campers Club (https://hyderabadcampersclubhcc.in/). One price per person at each campsite; availability and bookings on WhatsApp.

## Pages

- [Ananthagiri Hills Camping: 4 Campsites from ₹1,600](https://camping.hyderabadcampersclubhcc.in/): Ananthagiri Hills camping near Vikarabad, 2 hours from Hyderabad: compare 4 overnight camps (pool, adventure, lakeside, premium). Tents, meals and bonfire from ₹1,600.

- [Adventure Camping in Ananthagiri Hills with Rope Course | ₹2,000](https://camping.hyderabadcampersclubhcc.in/packages/adventure-camping/): Two-person tents, a rope course of about 10 activities, cycling, short trek, bonfire and movie night. Saturdays, 1 night / 2 days, ₹2,000 per person.
- [Budget Camping in Ananthagiri Hills with Pool & Music | ₹1,600](https://camping.hyderabadcampersclubhcc.in/packages/budget-camping-pool-music/): Tents, pool (5–10 pm), box cricket, Saturday DJ night, campfire and buffet meals near Vikarabad. 1 night / 2 days, ₹1,600 per person.
- [Lakeside Camping Near Hyderabad at Sarpanpally Lake | ₹2,000](https://camping.hyderabadcampersclubhcc.in/packages/lakeside-camping-sarpanpally/): Tents on the bank of Sarpanpally Lake near Vikarabad with a bonfire hour, games, live-kitchen meals and a farm visit. Saturdays, ₹2,000 per person.
- [Premium Camping in Ananthagiri Hills with Pool & Sunrise Trek | ₹2,999](https://camping.hyderabadcampersclubhcc.in/packages/premium-camping/): Tents on a private resort campsite with a pool, sports, bonfire and a guided 6 am sunrise trek. Saturdays, 1 night / 2 days, ₹2,999 per person.
- [Privacy Policy | Ananthagiri Hills Camping](https://camping.hyderabadcampersclubhcc.in/privacy-policy/): How Ananthagiri Hills Camping, run by Hyderabad Campers Club, handles enquiries, booking details, cookies, analytics and Google Ads measurement.
